summary: This RFC is the formal specification of the Exterior Gateway Protocol, used between gateways of different autonomous systems in the ARPA Internet. It updates parts of RFC 888 and RFC 827. It is historic as a protocol now.

eli5.summary: Neighboring networks needed a way to tell each other which addresses they can reach. EGP was an early way to share that routing news.

questions: what is the exterior gateway protocol
how did egp exchange routes between autonomous systems
